# The inline map has to carry the SNGL source itself. Its `sources` are
# resolved against the map's own location, and for html the map is inlined
# into a page: one emitted below the output root sits at a different depth
# from the one at the root, and over HTTP the .sngl is outside the document
# root either way. sourcesContent is what removes the need to resolve at
# all — and esbuild has to preserve it when it chains our SNGL->JS map
# through its own JS->bundle map.
#
# generate_maps_js_inline.txt only greps for a map being present; this one
# checks it points at something and carries the source.
[!node] skip

# Build from a subdirectory so the right `sources` label ("../src/app.sngl")
# is distinguishable from both the invocation path and a bare basename.
mkdir src
cp app.sngl src/app.sngl
rm app.sngl

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --opt=maps=true --out=out src/app.sngl
exists out/index.html

exec node check_map.js
stdout 'map ok'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component main {
    var count = 0
    text(value=string(count))
    button(text="+", @click { count += 1 })
}

-- check_map.js --
// Decode the inline source map out of index.html and check two things: the
// `sources` label resolves as a path relative to the map's own directory,
// and the map carries the SNGL text so no resolution is needed at all.
const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");

const html = fs.readFileSync("out/index.html", "utf8");
const m = html.match(/sourceMappingURL=data:application\/json;base64,([A-Za-z0-9+/=]+)/);
if (!m) {
    console.error("no inline source map in out/index.html");
    process.exit(1);
}
const map = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(m[1], "base64").toString("utf8"));

if (map.version !== 3) {
    console.error("source map version " + map.version + ", want 3");
    process.exit(1);
}
if (!map.sources || map.sources.length === 0) {
    console.error("source map names no sources");
    process.exit(1);
}

const snglIdx = map.sources.findIndex((s) => s.endsWith(".sngl"));
if (snglIdx < 0) {
    console.error("no .sngl among sources: " + map.sources.join(", "));
    process.exit(1);
}
const sngl = map.sources[snglIdx];

if (path.isAbsolute(sngl)) {
    // An absolute path resolves on the machine that built it and nowhere
    // else, so golden output must never carry one.
    console.error("absolute source path: " + sngl);
    process.exit(1);
}
if (!fs.existsSync(path.join("out", sngl))) {
    console.error("source " + sngl + " does not resolve from the map's directory");
    process.exit(1);
}

// esbuild rewrites the map when it chains ours through its own; the source
// text has to survive that, or a served page has no way back to the SNGL.
if (!Array.isArray(map.sourcesContent)) {
    console.error("map carries no sourcesContent");
    process.exit(1);
}
if (map.sourcesContent.length !== map.sources.length) {
    console.error("sourcesContent has " + map.sourcesContent.length +
        " entries for " + map.sources.length + " sources; it is positional");
    process.exit(1);
}
const text = map.sourcesContent[snglIdx];
if (typeof text !== "string" || !text.includes("component main")) {
    console.error("sourcesContent for " + sngl + " is not the SNGL source: " + JSON.stringify(text));
    process.exit(1);
}

console.log("map ok: " + sngl + " (" + text.length + " bytes of source)");
